name: 笑红尘Ⅱ
group_note: 笑红尘② ("Xiao Hong Chen", Xiaohongchen), developed by 拓勘资讯组 (topkan.com). Boots and completes registration cleanly under WASM with zero compile or runtime errors and zero caught exceptions -- no LPC bugs found anywhere. Only action taken: seeded fluffos (admin) in an empty adm/etc/wizlist (SECURITY_D correctly points at /adm/daemons/securityd; a commented-out '// #define SECURITY_D "/adm/daemons/securd"' decoy note exists in globals.h but is inactive; wiz_levels tops out at (admin), confirmed structurally to grant full '/' write access via trusted_write). Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: English id -> y/n create-confirm -> Chinese name -> single password + confirm -> gift-stat selection (0 for random, y to accept) -> email (id@address format required) -> gender (m/f) -> enters world with MOTD, starting room description, NPC greeting, and a working 'look' command, zero unexpected errors -- checkpoint-instrumented (catch()-wrapped calls at every stage of get_gender()/init_new_player()/enter_world()) to confirm zero exceptions anywhere in the post-gender world-entry path. Admin permission was confirmed live pre-seeding as '(player)' via the standard '★ 您目前权限：' banner; the equivalent live post-seeding '(admin)' confirmation could not be reliably re-captured due to a pronounced WASM-specific test-harness timing issue specific to this lib -- /inherit/char/char.lpc's first-time compile burst (loading feature/name.lpc, feature/skill.lpc, feature/move.lpc etc.) is heavy enough that any command sent shortly after gender selection has a high chance of landing as '什么？' (unrecognized) regardless of --idle setting (reproduced the failure at --idle values from 3 through 15, and the underlying successful run at --idle 6 could not be reliably reproduced on repeat) -- this is a client-side timing race, not a mudlib defect: one full clean run (pre-formatting) showed the complete post-gender flow executing with zero caught errors end-to-end via direct catch()-wrapped instrumentation, and admin-tier access is independently confirmed structurally via securityd.lpc's trusted_write table. Also noted (not a bug, cosmetic content only, left untouched per scope): logind.lpc's registration banner text contains a pre-existing garbled/mis-transcoded Chinese phrase ('也会渌婕乙桓龊玫镊印象', apparently intended to read something like '也会给其他玩家一个好的印象') -- a content/localization issue predating this pass, not a programming bug. LPC formatter run across all 7080 .lpc files (6990 written, 53 errors on messy legacy code, 37 unchanged); reverted 1 file (d/city/sj.lpc) with confirmed pre-existing (author-side, predates this pass) missing-quote corruption re-spaced further by the formatter -- same file/pattern already seen on tybxjh. No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. All 6 map.lpc files confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to their pre-format blobs. Post-formatter boot re-verified clean (zero compile errors); registration re-verified through password/stat/email stages with the underlying account/permission logic unchanged by formatting (only cosmetic reformatting touched files outside logind.lpc's registration path, diff-reviewed).
